chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The parents are liable for disobedience toward the child just as the child is liable toward them for disobedience.

key_terms.الْوَالِدَيْنِ: the two parents, referring to mother and father
key_terms.عُقُوقِ: undutifulness, wrongful conduct, or disobedient mistreatment within family relations
key_terms.يَلْزَمُ: is binding upon, is incumbent, or one is held accountable for

ai.seo_question: Are parents accountable for mistreating their children in the same way children are accountable for disobeying their parents?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that moral responsibility within the family is reciprocal, not one-sided. Just as children are blameworthy for undutifulness toward their parents, parents also bear responsibility when they wrong their children.
